name: spine-pipeline-mcp
description: Local Spine JSON, mesh, weight and animation tools with isolated staging.
long_description: Inspect Spine assets, edit meshes and animation in new staging jobs, and optionally use a separately installed licensed Spine CLI and Spine-enabled Godot. Requires distinct source and staging directories. A host supporting MCPB 0.4 UV runtime installs Python dependencies. Skills are installed separately through skills.sh or the repository plugin marketplaces.

source_root.title: Source assets directory
source_root.description: Existing absolute directory of asset copies; use a real path without symlinks.

staging_root.title: Staging output directory
staging_root.description: Separate absolute output directory; must not overlap or contain the source directory.

spine_cli.title: Licensed Spine executable (optional)
spine_cli.description: Absolute path to an existing, appropriately licensed Spine CLI. Not needed for JSON tools.

spine_cli_version.title: Exact Spine version (optional)
spine_cli_version.description: Required for native export when Spine is configured, for example 4.3.26; must match the asset.

godot_executable.title: Spine-enabled Godot executable (optional)
godot_executable.description: Absolute path to a Godot build containing native SpineSprite, for optional runtime checks.
